articles.title: NASA Mission Will Check Whether a Moon Pit Leads to a Giant Cave
articles.summary: NASA picked a project called GIMLI to find out whether a pit on the Moon opens into a hidden lava tube cave.

articles.title: This Year's El Niño Is Breaking Records, and It May Grow Stronger
articles.summary: Ocean temperatures show 2026's El Niño is the most intense on record by one measure, and scientists expect it to strengthen.

articles.title: Scientists Find New Giant Stick Insects Hiding in Plain Sight
articles.summary: Australian scientists found that two kinds of giant stick insects were really five, including a new species with lidded eggs.
